subject.title: feat(skills): add option to disable ~/.agents/skills scanning for Claude Code coexistence

question: Should OpenClaw add a public `skills.load` source-disable contract for `agents-skills-personal`, and should that contract be a typed source list, an ignore-dir list, or a narrower personal-source toggle?
rationale: The requested fix adds public configuration surface and changes built-in skill-source behavior; repository policy sets a high bar for new config knobs and requires maintainer intent before implementation.

options.title: Add a typed source-disable list
options.body: Expose a default-empty `skills.load.disableSources` constrained to known source ids and apply it before both discovery and watcher target registration.

options.title: Add a narrow personal-source toggle
options.body: Expose only a `skills.load.personalAgentsSkills` or equivalent boolean if maintainers want the smallest public API for this coexistence case.

options.title: Decline new config surface
options.body: Keep current behavior and document allowlists, prompt limits, and per-skill disables as the supported mitigations, accepting that scanning still occurs.

recommendation.title: Add a typed source-disable list
recommendation.body: Expose a default-empty `skills.load.disableSources` constrained to known source ids and apply it before both discovery and watcher target registration.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent skills loader, watcher, config, and docs history makes this the strongest available owner for the product/API choice.
